product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT’s HealthData Platform helps hospitals and health systems extract, migrate, convert, archive, and manage patient, financial, and business data to support patient care, compliance, and interoperability.
product_one_liner.notes: One-sentence summary of the platform description and its healthcare-delivery audience.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes HealthData Platform pricing models and project-pricing factors, even though it directs prospects to contact the company for a budgetary quote.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear in Harmony Healthcare IT case studies.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists 235 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: Novacap identifies Harmony Healthcare IT as headquartered in South Bend, Indiana, United States.

founded_year.notes: The company says it was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The Technical archive does not show two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built; the visible Parkview item is a customer/archiving story.

public_docs.notes: The public tutorial index contains multiple product tutorials, including Conversions, DR Dashboard, DR Auditor, and OpenGate.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open board lists six roles, none titled AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed product materials describe AI/NLP capabilities, but the public product documentation and Trust Center FAQ/resources do not name an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center compliance list names SOC 2 and HIPAA; other listed frameworks are outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: The latest round is listed as Private Equity - II on November 28, 2023. The amount is not disclosed in the funding table or the company announcement; 0 is used only as the schema-required neutral numeric value, not as a claim that the round raised zero dollars.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed funding round is dated November 28, 2023, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The six open roles include Associate Business Development Director and Business Development Director, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: No product or major-feature launch was identified from May 9 through November 9, 2026. The latest product-feature launch found, Legacy Record Indicator, is dated February 25, 2026; subsequent visible 2026 news included a partnership and company/survey announcements rather than a product launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Liddell was appointed CEO effective April 30, 2026, and Matt Cook was appointed CTO in March 2026; both changes fall within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Associate Business Development Director posting names Sugar CRM as a prospecting/pipeline tool.
